src.heading: INT. ANAADHI’S PRIMARY CABIN / LOWER CABIN PASSAGE / EXT. FOREST RAVINE – CONTINUOUS
src.start: BLACK. Anaadhi’s heartbeat returns once, twice, then violently fast.
src.end: They move deeper into the ravine.

Medical Specialist watches Anaadhi readings rise
Medical Specialist states motor activity is returning
MEDICAL SPECIALIST: Motor activity is returning.
POLICE COMMANDER: Put restraints on him.
Two officers move toward Anaadhi; no restraint is successfully applied before the floor drop
He feels concealed release groove beneath the wood, built years earlier for feared operations
Aarathi kneels near Anaadhi in the real cabin
Aarathi tells Anaadhi to listen to her voice
AARATHI: Anaadhi, listen to my voice.
Aarathi says she did not break it
AARATHI: I did not break it.
Aarathi says she gave it with his permission
AARATHI: I gave it with your permission.
Anaadhi asks whose permission allowed the force
ANAADHI: With whose permission did they bring force?
Aarathi has no answer; hold her reaction without adding dialogue
Police Commander reaches for Aarathi shoulder and orders her back
Anaadhi slams palm against hidden release
Floor beneath Anaadhi drops; lower escape panel opens once
Anaadhi falls into darkness below; preserve active ADK-7 motor impairment
Anaadhi catches Aarathi wrist; one suspended second between armed cabin and passage
Aarathi demands he not let go
AARATHI: Do not let go of my hand!
Anaadhi pulls Aarathi down; panel swings shut above them once
They crash into narrow timber tunnel; impact knocks air from Anaadhi
Anaadhi limbs still resist him from ADK-7; no new dose
Aarathi activates a small field light
Aarathi asks if he can move
Officers strike the floor above; do not reveal invented lower-level geometry
Aarathi says she does not know what ADK-7 is
AARATHI: I do not know what ADK-7 is.
Anaadhi says it was not explained to him either
ANAADHI: They did not explain it to me either.
Anaadhi pushes forward through constrained passage
Aarathi hears armed personnel entering lower level from another access; keep their path offscreen/unmapped
Aarathi asks where the tunnel goes
AARATHI: Where does the tunnel go?
Anaadhi says he told nobody when he built it
ANAADHI: When I built it, I told nobody.
Aarathi tells him to tell her now
Physical tunnel divides into exactly three real routes; no represented multiplication yet
SB074 onset: all three routes multiply across Parallel Earths; physical route graph remains underneath
SB074 represented route 1 contains armed police
SB074 represented route 3 leads into Paraane childhood corridor
Child Anaadhi stands inside the third represented route; explicit age-12 identity only
Child Anaadhi says the same road again
CHILD ANAADHI: The same road again.
RST01: vision disappears; same physical WC062 three-route tunnel returns with zero residue
Anaadhi chooses the physically narrowest real passage
Anaadhi answers that everyone assumes it is impossible for tall people
ANAADHI: Everyone assumes it is impossible for tall people.
Anaadhi forces his 193 cm frame through the cramped opening; preserve constrained clearance
Above, Police Commander receives three thermal readings moving in different directions; readings are sensor outputs, not three bodies
Police Technician reports three targets detected
POLICE TECHNICIAN (V.O.): Three targets are being detected.
Police Commander says there is only one subject in the cabin
POLICE COMMANDER (V.O.): There is only one subject in the cabin.
Police Technician tells him to explain that to the sensor
POLICE TECHNICIAN (V.O.): Please explain that to the sensor, sir.
Semmaa studies the old cabin structure rather than chasing sensor outputs
Semmaa orders them not to chase the sensor
SEMMAA: Do not chase the sensor.
Semmaa points toward water running beneath one wall
Semmaa tells them to find where the drainage goes
SEMMAA: Find where the drainage goes.
Concealed grate opens once beneath wet roots in LOC-060 / ENV-BHG-003 ravine
Anaadhi crawls out into adult-escape ravine; wet roots, rock cover, drainage-outlet relation
Aarathi follows through the same grate; searchlights sweep above ravine
Anaadhi catches Aarathi arm and draws her behind rock; she immediately pulls free
Aarathi states she is not a hostage
AARATHI: I am not a hostage.
Aarathi asks what he means; Anaadhi looks toward armed ridge
AARATHI: What do you mean by “not yet”?
Anaadhi says they see her as his shield; Aarathi asks and you
ANAADHI: They see you as my shield. | AARATHI: And you?
Anaadhi releases her completely and answers a voice; everyone else's voice has become a weapon
ANAADHI: A voice. | ANAADHI: Everyone else’s voice has become a weapon.
Aarathi says if they remain both will be captured; Anaadhi says she can go
AARATHI: If we remain here, they will capture both of us. | ANAADHI: You can go.
Aarathi says not before she records the seventeen-count confession; they move deeper into ravine — exact SC067 end
AARATHI: Not before I record the seventeen-count confession.
